Subject: SentraHealth - kickoff: MSA + Order Form

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — SentraHealth is excited to move forward. Legal and procurement asked me to start a short intake so we can get the right documents and evidence in front of the right people.

Quick asks to start:
- Can you send your current MSA and a blank order form / pricing attachment so we can map line items?
- We will need a short list of common clause positions (liability cap, indemnity, data residency) and your SOC 2 Type II contact for evidence.
- Our procurement team has a standard PO and supplier onboarding PDF; I attached the procurement form we typically use. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO + Order Form combo and who signs for Redwood.

Also: our legal team prefers a 3-business-day initial review turnaround if possible — does that timeline work for your legal/contracting team?

Please loop in anyone from your side who owns contracting and security.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
General Counsel
SentraHealth

Attachment: Sentra_Procurement_Form.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SentraHealth - kickoff: MSA + Order Form

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Jonas (contracts) and Marissa from our account team to coordinate the intake.

Attached: Redwood_MSA_v1.docx and Redwood_OrderForm_Template.xlsx — these are our standard starter templates. Our usual process is:
1) We send starter MSA + order form -> Counterparty sends any initial redlines -> Legal does first-pass -> Commercial team reviews pricing exhibits -> we return redlines and propose a short MAP.

A few quick answers to your bullets:
- 3-business-day initial review is doable for a first-pass from our legal team provided we have the counterparty party name and signatory details up front.
- We accept PO + signed order form in most cases; Procurement team sometimes requires a countersigned MSA if the PO includes additional terms — Jonas will confirm any exceptions.
- SOC 2 Type II evidence: please send a secure request to compliance@redwood.com or use the shared drive link (below). Our SOC 2 rep is Jenna Park.

Proposed next steps:
- Can we get SentraHealth’s legal party name and preferred signatory (legal name + title)?
- Suggest a 30-min sync on Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT to walk order form exhibits and billing cadence.

Links and attachments: Redwood_MSA_v1.docx; Redwood_OrderForm_Template.xlsx; https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_shared_drive

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--

Avery / Kimberly — thanks. I can confirm procurement details from our side:
- PO process: we issue PO after signature, finance needs vendor W9 and vendor code (we can create a new vendor once we have Redwood’s legal name and tax ID).
- Budget code: BH-2026-APPS (we’ll include on the PO).
- Typical turnaround: procurement can issue a PO within 5 business days after signature.

Two outstanding technical/regulatory asks from our side:
1) Data residency: we need to know whether Redwood stores logs or model telemetry in the US only or can commit EU residency for EU-subject data.
2) SOC 2: we requested a recent SOC 2 Type II and a contact for questions.

Attaching our Sentra_Procurement_Form.pdf filled-out for your reference. We’re generally OK with PO + Order Form but will escalate if the MSA has non-standard indemnity/liability language.

—Matt

Subject: Re: SentraHealth - kickoff: MSA + Order Form

Elena / Matt — thanks for the intake and the filled procurement form. A few items from Legal / Contracts: 

1) Timeline and scope for initial redline pass
- We can do a first-pass redline on the MSA + Order Form within 3 business days after receipt of SentraHealth’s legal party name and the preferred signatory. We will highlight high-priority commercial exceptions (liability cap, indemnity, termination for convenience, data residency).

2) Common negotiation touchpoints (so you can prepare):
- Liability: we commonly negotiate a per-incident and aggregate cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months.
- Indemnity: Redwood typically carries limited indemnity for IP and will seek to carve out certain security-related claims.
- Data residency & logs: we can commit to region-based hosting for production customer data on a case-by-case basis; telemetry/logs retention policies are linked below.

3) Evidence and contacts
- SOC 2 Type II: Jenna Park (compliance@redwood.com) will provide the report via a secure share once we receive a signed NDA or Secure Evidence Request form.
- Redwood legal contact for redlines: kimberly.park@redwood.com

4) Docs attached for your review
- redline-checklist.pdf (short checklist of what our team highlights on first-pass)
- For clarity I’ve included a sample clause commentary inline in the attached checklist.

Next operational steps:
- Elena: please confirm full legal entity name for SentraHealth and the signatory details so Jonas can prepare the countersignature matrix.
- Avery / Jonas / Marissa: I’ll aim to have the first-pass back by Wednesday (3 business days) once we have the info above. If there are commercial exceptions flagged by SentraHealth, let’s use a short MAP doc to track open items.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
